build.tree: the shared working tree at that commit with the uncommitted Q3Test work and other sessions' uncommitted changes

machine.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU (Vulkan and RTX device; the laptop also has Intel Iris Xe)

installations.source: the six Win32 packages whose archive hashes 2026-09-20-q3-point-releases.json records, laid down read-only under .tmp/q3test/install/<release>

recordingsDecoded.decoder: the independent Python decoder written from the retail engines (.tmp/q3test/re/q3test_demo_decode.py), re-encoding each record with its reference writers

reproduction.matrix: bash .tmp/q3test/tools/run_matrix.sh -r4, then bash .tmp/q3test/tools/run_extras.sh -r4, from the repository root; each run() line is one scripts/probe_q3test.py invocation whose --output is .tmp/q3test/probes/<name>. The rtd runs time-demo the retail engines and use no fnTech3 binary.
matrixScript: # The Q3Test evidence matrix: every client release against every peer, the
# menus, demos, recordings, and the protocol client against every server.
case $r in 1.06|1.07|1.08) run m$t-tn$S fntech3-client --installation $I --release $r --server $B/fntech3.ded.exe --client $B/fntech3.exe --target fntech3 --map q3tourney --timeout 90;; esac
run m$t-vk$S fntech3-client --installation $I --release $r --server $B/fntech3.ded.exe --client $B/fntech3.exe --target fntech3 --map q3test2 --client-set cl_renderer vk --timeout 120
run m$t-rx$S fntech3-client --installation $I --release $r --server $B/fntech3.ded.exe --client $B/fntech3.exe --target fntech3 --map q3test2 --client-set cl_renderer rtx --timeout 150
# 128 slots, as every release allows: a public client lands in slot 120.
# 1.02 reserves its private slots with privateclients and the rcon
# password; 1.03 and later with sv_privateClients and sv_privatePassword.
if [ $r = 1.02 ]; then HI="--server-set privateclients 120"; else HI="--server-set sv_privateClients 120 --server-set sv_privatePassword reserved"; fi

run h106-rl$S retail-client --installation .tmp/q3test/install/1.06 --release 1.06 --server $B/fntech3.ded.exe --timeout 120 --hold 25 --server-set sv_maxclients 128 --server-set sv_privateClients 120 --server-set sv_privatePassword reserved --rcon 12 status
extrasScript: # The runs beside the matrix: path-traced RTX views and the second shipped
# recordings' time demos, on the same build.

run m$t-pt$S fntech3-client --installation .tmp/q3test/install/$r --release $r --server $B/fntech3.ded.exe --client $B/fntech3.exe --target fntech3 --map q3test2 --client-set cl_renderer rtx --client-set rtx_rt_mode 2 --client-set rtx_rt_require 0 --timeout 180
